title: SolarWinds NPM or PRTG Network Monitor: Choosing a Network Monitoring Tool
excerpt: Two established commercial network monitoring platforms. SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor targets large, complex networks; PRTG from Paessler is known for quick setup and sensor-based pricing.
verdict: SolarWinds NPM is the stronger option for large, complex enterprise networks that need deep monitoring. PRTG is faster to deploy and easier to budget for, which suits mid-sized teams.

spec1.label: Depth for large enterprise networks
spec1.device1Value: Very strong in complex enterprise environments
